summary: Four Corners Property Trust, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement No. 2 to update its existing ATM equity distribution program, increasing the sales agent and forward purchaser roster by adding Citigroup Global Markets Inc. and Citibank, N.A. No shares have been sold under the agreement to date; up to $500 million of common stock remains available for offer and sale. This is a routine shelf takedown and ATM program amendment, not a special situation. The filing includes no transaction terms, pricing, premiums, or strategic event. It is solely a registered offering document update.
